invocation.text: Use orchestrate-feature for #1893. I give you explicit permission to approve as many review rounds as are reasonable for each ticket and merge the PRs yourself.

authority.reviewRounds: the coordinator's checkpoint decision after round 3's verified fixes and after every later round's, published on the PR through review-checkpoint.mjs, with this invocation as the authority for an extension within ten rounds or an acceptance of verified final corrections
authority.merge: the coordinator merges this Feature's PRs that pass integration.mjs's merge gate, with an expected-head merge call and never a bypass of branch protection
authority.diskRecovery: the guarded clean-worktrees classifier's merged-and-removable entries only, each recorded here

concurrency.basis: invocation override (default would be 3: the smaller of 3 (reviewer slots) and 7 by memory at 4 GB per writer; each plan also admits only as many writers as free disk allows at 6 GB per writer)
